newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly mixed.

text.p: U.S. spot millfeed prices were mixed in lackluster early week activity, dealers said.
Typically, there is very little business done on a Monday, a Carolinas dealer said.
A Minneapolis dealer agreed. "Nobody really has a sense of direction here. We are counting on a short week next week," he said.
Several dealers said they expect mills to reduce their runtimes during the Thanksgiving holiday week.
"A lot of people (mills) will not be running full time next week," a Tennessee dealer said.
In the Northeast, mills also were likely to decrease run times.

"It is tough to get a quote out now for nearby," a Buffalo dealer said. "We have the holiday coming and some question about runtime so, it may not be until Wednesday, until we see an established market."
One Texas dealer, who reported a spot trade at $105.00 a ton, said the only interest he has seen was on the nearby.
